sections.heading: Commands and gotchas
sections.body: <!-- Build, test and run commands that work, and the traps already met. -->

pane.label: Start my day
pane.prompt: Start my day: show what is waiting for me, what is overdue and what I should do first.

pane.label: Add a task
pane.prompt: I want to add a task. Ask me what it is and which project it belongs to.

pane.label: Plan this change
pane.prompt: Plan the change I am about to make before any code is written.

pane.label: Build the plan
pane.prompt: Implement the approved plan one phase at a time, test first.

pane.label: Run all checks
pane.prompt: Run every check on this repo and tell me how many actually ran.

pane.label: Commit when green
pane.prompt: Commit once the checks pass and a test receipt covers the changes.

pane.label: Save learnings
pane.prompt: Write down what we learned in this session.

pane.label: Write a handoff
pane.prompt: Write a handoff for the next session so nothing is lost.

pane.label: Open a project
pane.prompt: Open a project for me. Ask me which one.

pane.label: Find in my notes
pane.prompt: Look something up in my notes. Ask me what I am looking for.

pane.label: Check gt
pane.prompt: Check that my gt install is healthy.
